finalText:
Build's clean now. Two real bugs from the bump, both fixed:

1. `resolveRetries` in `src/core/options.js` was still reading `options.retries`, but the new bundler passes `retryCount`. It crashed on `undefined.toFixed()`.
2. `isBackoffEnabled` in `src/net/retryPolicy.js` threw on `undefined` flags. The new config loader leaves unset flags as `undefined` instead of `false`, so it now just treats anything not `true` as disabled.

Ran `node build.js`: exits 0, `8 warnings, 0 errors`. The rest of the noise was just deprecation and dedupe log spam from the bump, harmless.
